cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The demonstrated behavior is recursive object merging, not code generation or injection. CWE-94 requires actual code construction from input, but this function only manipulates object properties.

connection.evidence: External input flows from function parameters to object property assignment, but the connection stops at data manipulation rather than code generation.

diff_causality.evidence: The added condition enables recursive merging, which could propagate prototype pollution deeper into nested structures.

security_control.required_control: Input validation for code generation contexts
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-94 requires controls to prevent code injection when constructing code from input
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No code generation is demonstrated, so the CWE-94 control requirement is not applicable to the evidenced mechanism

concrete_impact.evidence: No code generation or execution impact is demonstrated. The function only performs object property assignment.

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, recursive merging of nested objects would not occur, limiting prototype pollution to shallow properties only.

contradicting_evidence: No code generation, compilation, or execution operations are present
